clips.title: The story
paras: You carry General Marcus Jonathan's reply from Stormwind to Lakeshire, where Blackrock orcs and gnolls threaten the town. The capital offers no troops, leaving the settlement to face danger while Stormwind's leaders delay.

You brought Magistrate Solomon's plea for reinforcements to General Marcus Jonathan in Stormwind. Now you carry his preliminary reply back to Redridge while he waits for approval from the throne. Without royal authorization, the General cannot commit the army. Lakeshire's citizens remain without city guards, and each day brings the settlement closer to falling under the Blackrock clan.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: While I wait for a response from the King I want you to carry this letter to Magistrate Solomon.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Did the General send news? Are reinforcements on the way?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thank you for your time, adventurer. For your service to Lakeshire and Stormwind I reward you with these coins.
Now if you'll excuse me, I find this correspondence somewhat of a mystery. Something is amiss in our Kingdom. I fear this is the beginning of conflict, not the end.
